american_english: Frequently performed in the spring season, the seasonal Raga Basant has been mentioned in musical treatises from ancient times to the present, and is also prevalent in practical performance. The main objective of the present study is to broaden the storehouse of raga knowledge by providing music teachers, students, critics, reviewers, and connoisseurs of classical music with an overview of the wide domain of Raga Basant. Gathering data through sources such as the study of various musical treatises, discussions on the raga with scholarly musical artists, and listening to recorded Raga Basant, an analysis has been conducted in the present study. The application of this type of raga study serves primarily to provide proper instruction to music students, expand the domain of raga contemplation and knowledge, and preserve the raga alive from extinction. In studying Raga Basant through the present study, it was found that differing notes have been used.
